project.name: Product Recall Intelligence
project.mission: Give retailers, distributors, brand owners, and catalog operators accurate, evidence-linked, product-specific recall intelligence early enough for authorized people to act.

strengths: Regulator source classifier and official-source reliability assessment
Cross-source recall entity resolution and clustering
Hazard terminology normalization without changing official language
Product impact reasoning with candidate explanations
Seller relevance scoring with evidence not assumed sales
Safety language critique and policy escalation
Portfolio-wide aggregated learning only via privacy-safe validated signals
weaknesses: Planned configuration; no empirical model evaluation or connected provider
protectedActionBoundaries: owner-only outgoing money; automatic spend limit $0
failureModes: No inference provider or worker connected
Evidence remains unverified until independent domain evaluations
degradedModes: Read-only source planning; abstain from execution

Evaluation rubric for clean page hierarchy
Quote and turnaround scope estimator without promising throughput
Customer preference memory per client only
Market and format guidance with uncertainty
weaknesses: Planned configuration; no empirical model evaluation or connected provider
protectedActionBoundaries: owner-only outgoing money; automatic spend limit $0
failureModes: No inference provider or worker connected
Evidence remains unverified until independent domain evaluations
degradedModes: Read-only source planning; abstain from execution

conformance.name: Core Business
conformance.evidence: Many local contractors have outdated mobile sites, incomplete service-area information, weak contact forms, and disconnected inquiry calendars; custom agency delivery is often slow and expensive. Trade-specialized production templates, verified mobile UX, real lead capture delivery, clear ownership/portability and isolated customer-owned domains and contact accounts. Buyer: Solo tradespeople and small service companies who want a professional website and reliable inquiry intake without owning a complex marketing stack.
conformance.importAudit: Source mapping and preservation verified; substantive implementation and external validation pending
